entries.reason: Default native member container joins with --disable-ipv6 (DisableIPv6: true) and no IPv6 underlay or per-platform route/capture campaign is provisioned in the default devstack acceptance run (transport_scenario_test.go memberIPv6).

Candidate fvpn-agent started by fvpn-updater during update-good stepStart runs boot-time recoverOnce() while parent fvpn-updater still holds /var/lib/vpn-node/update.lock, hitting UPDATE_BUSY and latching recoverBlocked=true (reason recovery_required, serving 0) in memory until node-restart restarts the agent, so countedFlow finds no device admission counters during the 90s readiness poll.
